issues.evidence: P10: missing input file -> 'FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory' traceback (A/data_dedup.py:69)
issues.summary: Missing input file crashes with an unhandled traceback instead of a clean error message.

issues.evidence: P16: non-UTF-8 input -> 'UnicodeDecodeError' traceback; P18: output in nonexistent dir -> FileNotFoundError traceback (A/data_dedup.py:122)
issues.summary: Decode errors and unwritable output paths are not caught, so the user sees raw tracebacks.

issues.evidence: static/A-ruff.txt: C901 main too complex (15), B904, 8x UP031
issues.summary: main() is long and complex; it mixes % formatting and has an unused parameter (ncols_hint).
Adds unrequested options (--no-header, --ignore-case, --strip, --delimiter, --encoding, stdin/stdout); they don't change the defaults, but they enlarge the surface.

issues.evidence: manual run: rows '2' and '3' lacking the region column -> 'Duplicates found: 1; removed: 1', row '3' dropped (B/data_dedup.py:12)
issues.summary: Short rows get their missing key columns padded with "", so unrelated malformed rows are silently merged and deleted as duplicates.

issues.evidence: static/B-ruff.txt: B905 zip without strict, F401 unused sys in tests, E501
issues.summary: Minor lint issues: a zip() call without strict= and an unused import in the tests.
Loads the whole input into memory, which is fine for typical CSVs but not streaming.

blinding_guess.why: B ships a test suite with one test per stated requirement (composite, first, last, error, summary, stdlib-only), which looks like spec-driven work, while A is a feature-rich script with no tests.

notes: Both implementations handle the core dedup logic correctly, including composite keys, keep-first, keep-last (output ordered by the kept row's position in both), the error strategy, and the summary. A fails 3 of the 18 probes, all for unhandled I/O and decode exceptions that end in tracebacks. B passes all probes, but it silently drops malformed short rows by treating their missing key values as empty strings. In that same malformed-row case A exits with a clean error. Bandit reported nothing for either side.
